subject: Finalizing revenue inputs for Aug board packet
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acmeinc.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Finalizing revenue inputs for Aug board packet

Team —

We're in the final stretch for the Aug board packet. I attached the current exports (board_metrics_source.csv and pipeline_commit_matrix.xlsx). Please do a focused hygiene pass on your owned deals by EOD tomorrow:

- Stage accuracy: update any deals that have moved between Negotiation/Contract/Closed-Won in the last 30 days.
- ARR recognition: confirm the ARR calculation and effective start date for closed-won items.
- Evidence: flag any deals that need PDFs (SOWs / signed quotes) and add to the Drive folder.

Karthik — can you run a quick cross-check vs our bookings schedule (I left a note on row 2 of the sheet where I saw a discrepancy)?
Vivek / Marissa — please prepare a one-paragraph narrative (~2 sentences) that explains any >$100k fluctuation vs last month (include root cause). Emma from Atlas is expecting the headline ARR and a short color sentence for the investor appendix.

Attachments: board_metrics_source.csv, pipeline_commit_matrix.xlsx

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing revenue inputs for Aug board packet

On 2026-08-16 09:12, Ben Carter wrote:
> Team —
> 
> We're in the final stretch for the Aug board packet. I attached the current exports...

Thanks Ben — quick notes inline: 

- I found three deals in Negotiation that actually have signed counters (we received e-signed quotes). I'll move those to Closed-Won but will mark the ARR effective date as the original PO acceptance date (two have deferred starts, watch revenue recognition).
- Deal 4921 (HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/67890) needs the signed SOW uploaded; I've pinged procurement@acmeinc.com for the document.
- For any >$200k moves, I'm going to flag as "probable" in the matrix so the board can see the risk-adjusted corridor.

I'll make the edits and re-upload the matrix by EOD.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing revenue inputs for Aug board packet

Thanks — I'll run the commit verification pass first thing. Deliverables: 

1) commit_verification_report.csv (attached) — contains deal-level checkboxes: contract received, billing terms confirmed, ARR start date verified.
2) Updated matrix uploaded to the Drive (see sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BoardMetricsExample, tab: "RevOps_Final").

Note: two deals (IDs 5012, 5033) have ambiguous PO acceptance dates; I've added comments for AM owners to confirm. If we don't get confirmation by Thursday noon I'll conservatively move them to the "late" corridor.

Attachments: commit_verification_report.csv

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Revenue Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Emma Lewis <emma@atlasvc.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Quick confirmation for Aug investor appendix

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the heads-up. For the investor appendix we just need: 1) the headline ARR number you plan to present and 2) a two-line explanation for any material swing vs June. Can you confirm those by EOD Thursday?

Appreciate it —
Emma Lewis
Associate, Atlas Ventures
emma@atlasvc.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Lewis <emma@atlasvc.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finalizing revenue inputs for Aug board packet — action list and sign-off timeline

Quick status and next steps: 

- Vivek: thanks for the signed-counter updates — please upload the PDFs to the Drive folder and mark the deals as Closed-Won in the matrix (deadline: today 5pm PT).
- Marissa: thanks for the verification report. For the two ambiguous POs, please leave them in the "late" corridor if we don't get confirmation by today noon.
- Karthik: please reconcile the bookings schedule row I flagged (diff of ~$85k) and confirm whether it's a timing vs recognition issue.

Emma — proposed headline to use in investor appendix: "ARR: $48.2M (net of known churn); month-over-month variance driven by two large enterprise contracts shifting recognition timing. See board packet for deal-level notes." If that reads ok to you I'll lock it in.

Final ask: internal sign-off on the Drive file by Friday 5pm PT. If anyone needs an extra hour of runway, reply all and call it out.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
